Possible values: `email_was_unlocked` — email was successfully unlocked in this request; `already_unlocked` — email was unlocked previously and is returned from My Network without spending a token; `empty_email` — no email address exists for this creator in HypeAuditor, nothing to unlock; `mynetwork_size_limit_reached` — unlock failed because the team has reached the maximum number of creators in My Network, token refunded; `unexpected_error` — all unlock attempts failed, no email returned and no token charged.
